newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada new housing price index rises in March.
newsitem.headline: Canada new housing price index rises in March.

text.p: Canada's new housing price index rise 0.2 percent in March to 132.5 (base 1986) from March 1996, Statistics Canada said on Monday.
Index March yr pct month pct
The index measures changes of contractors' selling prices of new residential houses.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast a 1.7 percent rise in the annual index.
Statistics Canada said this was the first time since June 1994 that the annual change in the index has been positive.
The agency said the improvement in housing markets in recent months has been attributable to higher consumer confidence coupled with favorable interest rates.
